model_output.rationale: Both lines denied CO-29 (timely filing). But the 277CA shows STC*A2:20 on 2025-02-10 — the claim was accepted by the payer's front end 12 days after the 2025-01-29 DOS. No commercial limit is that short. The CO-29 is erroneous; appeal with the acceptance report.

root_cause.explanation: Payer issued CO-29 on both lines, but 277CA confirms front-end acceptance (A2:20) on 2025-02-10 — 12 days post-DOS. The filing was timely; the denial is wrong.

next_action.detail: File redetermination/first-level appeal citing the 277CA acceptance date (2025-02-10) as proof of timely receipt. Attach the 277CA with TRN TRC16862806 and STC A2:20. Dispute the CO-29 on both lines.

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*29 on both service lines; MOA N211; $0 paid on $116.52 billed
evidence.locator: CAS segments under SVC HC:97110 and HC:97140

evidence.fact: STC*A2:20 dated 2025-02-10 confirms payer front-end acceptance of claim TRC16862806
DOS 2025-01-29 — claim accepted 12 days later, within any commercial filing window
Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report; dispute the receipt date
CO-29 with no exception → do_not_resubmit; but where proof rebuts the date, appeal is the remedy
